description: Apply a single-file unified diff to one existing UTF-8 text file. Use when you hold a unified diff. Do not use it for one exact snippet; use `edit` instead. For pattern matches use `replace_text`; for new files, `create`. All or nothing: if any hunk mismatches its context, nothing is written; INVALID_INPUT usually names it. Header line numbers may be off. A diff of context lines only writes nothing and records no undo. File lines x diff lines over 10,000,000 fails with TOO_LARGE. Returns path, linesAdded, linesRemoved, size, lineCount, mimeType, kind, modified, resourceUri when linkable, and an undo id for `undo` (30 minutes) or undoUnavailable; dryRun adds the resulting diff.

diff.description: Single-file unified diff, at least one @@ hunk, hunks in file order. Multi-file diffs are rejected; a leading BOM is ignored.

dryRun.description: Check every hunk and return the resulting diff; write nothing. Counts come from the recomputed diff unless it times out.

path.description: Existing text file to patch. Overrides the ---/+++ names in diff.

name: patch
title: Patch
